controller_12m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p472; the Rule 10.07(1)(b) control-preserving second-six-month clause and its dates (first free 2027-02-07, last restricted 2027-02-06) are correct and unchanged. However the candidate MISSED a longer lock-up by a Controlling Shareholder: the Lock-Up Undertakings section (p477) states verbatim: 'In addition, the 11,283,000 Shares held by Cheuk Sing Ho are subject to a lock-up arrangement for the period of 30 months commencing from the Listing Date'. Cheuk Sing Ho is named a Controlling Shareholder ('our Controlling Shareholders, namely, Mr. Wang, Cheuk Sing Ho, the Concert Parties and Distinct Partners I Limited', p477); its shares therefore stay restricted until the 30-month anniversary 2028-08-06, beyond the slot's 2027-02-07 first free day. (Separately, 12-month lock-ups on Mr. CAO Shaoshan/Nineteen Seventy-Seven and Proxy Shares and an 18-month ESOP lock-up on Distinct Partners I/II shares (p477) are non-controller or out-of-scope arrangements.) Correction enriches basis/holders; slot dates for the Rule 10.07 element unchanged.
